answer: Each agent identity must lock 460 POA for 130 days in its vault, and the stake cannot be split or lent, so a thousand fakes tie up 460,000 POA for four months. Three auditors chosen at random inspect the agent's first jobs through a prism review that separates original work from copied output. Every job route is logged as a canyon trail, so a second identity cannot replay the same trip and claim it as its own. An agent caught faking loses the whole bond and its identity is burned.
